description: This Java class 'ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper' creates 'CreateThing' commands from templates, substituting placeholders with message headers, and maps external messages to internal protocol adaptables for the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper
classes.description: A Java class that maps external messages to internal CreateThing commands, substituting placeholders, and handles configuration and mapping logic within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with properties such as thing template, command headers, and policy lockout option.

methods.name: validateThingEntityId
methods.description: Validates the thing ID, ensuring it is either a placeholder or a valid ThingId.

methods.name: validatePolicyEntityId
methods.description: Validates the policy ID, ensuring it is either a placeholder or a valid PolicyId.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list containing an Adaptable with a CreateThing command.

methods.name: getExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for placeholders based on message headers.

methods.name: applyPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a template string using the provided resolver.

methods.name: getCreateThingSignal
methods.description: Constructs a CreateThing signal from a message and template.

methods.name: resolveCommandHeaders
methods.description: Resolves command headers with placeholder substitution based on message headers.

methods.name: createInlinePolicyJson
methods.description: Creates inline policy JSON object if present in the thing JSON.

methods.name: getCopyPolicyFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the copy policy source from the thing JSON.

methods.name: map (Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable to a list of ExternalMessages, especially error responses.
